# Austin Braids

> Hair braiding studio based in Round Rock, Texas. Knotless, feed-ins, boho braids, twists and stitch braids by Nancy in Round Rock. Precise parts, neat ends and a chair where you feel right at home.

- Phone: (512) 202-5181
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Austin, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Hutto, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 5.0 from 6 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/austin-braids/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/austin-braids/book.html

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Light, neat, natural-looking braids in the size and length you want.
- Feed-in & lemonade braids: Cornrow styles that lie flat and look sharp, from straight-backs to side-swept lemonade braids.
- Boho & goddess braids: Braids with curly pieces for a soft, romantic look that moves.
- Passion twists: Full, springy twists with a bohemian finish, in black or an ombre blend.
- Stitch & ponytail braids: Crisp stitch cornrows and sleek ponytail styles with accents.
- Curls & styling: Soft, bouncy curls and styling for when you want hair that turns heads.

## About
Austin Braids is Nancy's braiding studio on the I-35 frontage road in Round Rock. Clients come for knotless and box braids, feed-ins, boho braids, passion twists and stitch braids, and they come back for the way she works: careful parts, neat ends and real attention to detail. It's a friendly chair. Clients talk about the music, the good vibes and how comfortable Nancy makes them feel from start to finish. Not sure what style you want? Bring an inspiration photo and she'll guide you through the options that suit you.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What braid styles do you do?
  A: Knotless and box braids, feed-in and lemonade braids, boho and goddess braids, passion twists, stitch and ponytail braids, plus curls and styling. Not sure? Send a photo of the look you want.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 202-5181 if you're not sure.
- Q: Where is Austin Braids?
  A: 1500 S I-35 Frontage Rd, Round Rock, TX 78681. It's an easy drive from Austin, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Hutto and Cedar Park.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Call or text (512) 202-5181, or send a request through the booking page with your style and an inspiration photo, and Nancy will get back to you to set a time.
- Q: Can you help me choose a style?
  A: Yes. Clients say Nancy is great at walking them through braid styles and options. Bring a photo or just tell her what you're going for.
